daily_plan_req: Linda Taylor is active in the coffee shop from 8 am to 4 pm, and does not leave. She works her full shift while keeping an attentive ear on customer conversations; when climate change comes up, she frames it as a pressing health-and-safety concern and stresses that timely, system-wide measures matter. If customers ask about solutions, she expresses confidence in public institutions and explains, in plain language, how standards, funding, and coordinated planning can translate into real protections people can notice locally. During a brief lull, she updates the in-cafe chalkboard with a short, practical prompt titled "What Government Can Do Now: Clean Air, Heat Safety, and Resilient Services," then returns to taking orders and checking in with regulars about any community updates they’ve heard.
